title: Forty-seven percent of sampled moments
hook: Two stated cases: explore the sampled-moment denominator in a reported share.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the sampled-moment denominator in a reported share affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Added, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the sampled-moment denominator in a reported share in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
